findings.consequence: When publication or NAS upload retries are exhausted and connection or lock release also fails, the task remains failed and reports both errors. The flow has no release-failure branch after STORE, so it omits that warning and its associated cleanup uncertainty.
findings.correction: Add a release-failure path from the publication failure outcome to RELEASEFAIL, preserving the failed status and warning.

evidence: src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:800-812 retries publication and raises after exhaustion; lines 1047-1081 mark the attempt failed and append a release warning when storage.close() raises.
src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:765-798 retains the active slot across download retries and stops on cancellation, pause, exhausted publication retries, or release failure.
src/uav_downloader/daemon/task_manager.py:672-719 and src/uav_downloader/daemon/download_files.py:106-116 implement cancellation cleanup and preserve files with unknown ownership.

tests/test_daemon_downloads.py:321-419 and 1348-1475 cover retry, pause, cancellation, cleanup, release failure and publication exhaustion; tests/test_nas.py:571-594 covers upload retry after partial publication.
limitations: Read-only review; application and tests were not executed, and no execution results were supplied.
Mermaid rendering and live NAS behavior were not verified.
